How we work

A true partner on the search, start to finish.

We're a retained search partner, not a CV pipeline. Our AI experts sit alongside your team from the brief through the first ninety days.

Step 01 · Before the search

Shape the role together

What this person needs to deliver in year one, where they sit, and which adjacent roles can wait. We work it out with you before anyone writes a job description.

Step 02 · The search

We find and interview them

Our AI experts approach the market directly and personally interview everyone who reaches your shortlist. You see the reasoning behind each recommendation, not just a name.

Step 03 · After the offer

We stay for the first 90 days

We stay available once they start, thinking through the early calls on team, tools and spend with both of you while there's still room to adjust.

Where you are today

“Hire an AI leader” is really four different roles.

Which one fits depends on where your company is right now. Working that out together is usually the most valuable half-hour of the whole process.

A few experiments, nobody owns it Head of Applied AI

Focus the work on the few ideas with a business owner and a number attached, and set a baseline you can measure against.

The demos are great, nothing is live Director of AI Engineering

Take one job people do every day and get it fully live — owned, monitored, and costed up front.

One thing works, now everyone wants it VP of Artificial Intelligence

Turn a single success into something other teams can reuse and run themselves, rather than queueing behind one central team.

The business depends on it now Chief AI Officer

Own AI the way a CFO owns money: what's running, what it's exposed to, and the authority to switch something off.

On every candidate

A scorecard written against your role.

Two of our AI experts score every shortlisted candidate on what actually decides whether an AI leader succeeds at your stage and in your industry — strengths and the areas to watch, both, so you can plan around them before the offer goes out.
